edge_preload_2026-11-26.result: Preload works (image request starts ~0.5 s, before the JS bundle finishes) but product LCP is unchanged at 2.84 s. Target 1.8 s NOT met. Remaining cost: element render delay about 1.08 s, because the gallery only renders after the JS bundle and GET /api/products/:slug complete. Inlining product JSON into the HTML was rejected (see lcp_decision_2026-11-26).

lcp_decision_2026-11-26.reason: Product LCP is limited by the product API waterfall (image renders after GET /api/products/:slug). Inlining product JSON into the Pages Function HTML was rejected: stock and price edits in /admin would require HTML cache invalidation. Product data stays on the single API path with the public s-maxage=300 cache purged by admin mutations.

decisions: image limits full 500 KB / thumb 300 KB (Phase 7; full lowered from 3 MB)
canonical-key cache purge; filtered variants expire at s-maxage=300
browser WebP fallback to image/jpeg q0.82 accepted; real Content-Type stored with the blob in D1 (R2 dropped in Phase 7)
rate_limits(key, attempted_at) replaces login_attempts; POST /api/orders capped 5 per 15 min per IP (deviates from spec table name, approved)
Phase 7: default subdomains; Pages Functions proxy /api, /images, /sitemap.xml, /robots.txt to the Worker; no R2, images in D1 blobs
